items.title: Restore advertised nested Lab command routing
items.context: Real CLI lab create --help fails while lab_create exists.
items.userSees: lab create --help displays registered Lab help; all six nested Lab forms resolve like their flat equivalents.

happy.desc: All six advertised lab subcommands resolve to their registered flat handlers, including real CLI lab create --help returning command help successfully.

edge.desc: Flat Lab commands remain available and nested aliases preserve forwarded arguments without altering handler behavior.

adversarial.desc: Unknown lab subcommands remain unmatched and fail as unknown commands rather than silently selecting a registered handler.

items.title: Align transport environment regression coverage with canonical names
items.context: Historical frozen key list is not the active transport matching surface; preserve semantic inputs and historical digest.
items.userSees: Transport-only canonical environment changes preserve validation identity; semantic changes still invalidate it; the DONE-required smoke passes.

happy.desc: Changing ambient canonical PROOF_OR_STOP transport identity keys leaves the effective validation environment digest unchanged.

edge.desc: Frozen historical transport key list and its pinned digest remain unchanged while retired LATTICE spellings are not active transport matches.

adversarial.desc: Semantic ambient values and explicit command.env overlays, including overlays of normally transport-only keys, remain digest-sensitive.
